# Vendored Dependencies

## tree-sitter-racket

Vendored via `git subtree` from https://github.com/6cdh/tree-sitter-racket.

Edit files and commit normally — no special workflow needed.

To pull upstream changes:

```sh
git subtree pull --prefix=vendor/tree-sitter-racket https://github.com/6cdh/tree-sitter-racket.git main --squash
```
